name: pcc_geo_cnn_v2
paper: Improved Deep Point Cloud Geometry Compression
protocol_note: Same Experiment 019 source records quantized to the upstream ModelNet 512^3 global grid and partitioned at octree level 3 into the model's native 64^3 occupancy blocks; actual emitted gzip streams only. Reconstructions are mapped back to normalized coordinates and measured on the common 12-bit evaluation grid. D1-optimized external streams are primary; D2 optimization requires a separately labeled run with source normals.
